metadata.question: Did the air temperature reach over 50 degrees Celsius at the Furnace Creek Visitor's Center on June 30, 2013?

data.raw_code:
<thinking>
1. Search strategy: Use GRIDMET daily tmmx over Furnace Creek VC point for 2013-06-30. If unavailable, fallback to ERA5-Land hourly temperature_2m (daily max), then ERA5 hourly.
2. Masking strategy: No cloud mask needed (reanalysis data). Validate coverage via pixel count in a 5 km buffer.
3. Logic: If collections empty => C1. If valid pixels = 0 after masking => C2. If value null/NaN/unrealistic => C3. Otherwise compare daily max Celsius > 50 to decide A/B.
</thinking>

<code>
```javascript
const ee = require('@google/earthengine');
const privateKey = require('../auth_keys/test-project-473922-29f05d49bed7'); // You must include this line

async function runAnalysis() {
  try {
    // Helper to await getInfo
    const getInfo = (obj) =>
      new Promise((resolve, reject) => obj.getInfo((v, e) => (e ? reject(e) : resolve(v))));

    // 1. Geometry & Time Definitions
    const pt = ee.Geometry.Point([-116.8669, 36.4623]); // Furnace Creek Visitor Center (approx)
    const start = ee.Date('2013-06-30');
    const end = ee.Date('2013-07-01');
    const region = pt.buffer(5000).bounds(); // 5 km buffer for stable sampling
    const scale = 10000;

    console.log('Location: Furnace Creek Visitor Center (approx)');
    console.log('Date: 2013-06-30');

    // 2. Data Acquisition & Check with fallbacks
    let dataset = 'IDAHO_EPSCOR/GRIDMET';
    let band = 'tmmx';
    let img = null;

    let col = ee.ImageCollection(dataset).filterBounds(pt).filterDate(start, end).select(band);
    let n = await getInfo(col.size());
    console.log(`GRIDMET Images: ${n}`);
    if (n === 0) {
      dataset = 'ECMWF/ERA5_LAND/HOURLY';
      band = 'temperature_2m';
      let col2 = ee.ImageCollection(dataset).filterBounds(pt).filterDate(start, end).select(band);
      let n2 = await getInfo(col2.size());
      console.log(`ERA5-Land Hourly Images: ${n2}`);
      if (n2 === 0) {
        dataset = 'ECMWF/ERA5/HOURLY';
        band = 'temperature_2m';
        let col3 = ee.ImageCollection(dataset).filterBounds(pt).filterDate(start, end).select(band);
        let n3 = await getInfo(col3.size());
        console.log(`ERA5 Hourly Images: ${n3}`);
        if (n3 === 0) {
          console.log('No images found for date/location.');
          console.log('C1');
          return;
        }
        // Use ERA5 hourly daily max
        img = col3.max();
      } else {
        // Use ERA5-Land hourly daily max
        img = col2.max();
      }
    } else {
      // GRIDMET daily tmmx (already daily max)
      img = ee.Image(col.first());
    }

    // 3. Processing: pixel count to detect C2
    const countDict = await getInfo(
      img.select(band).reduceRegion({
        reducer: ee.Reducer.count(),
        geometry: region,
        scale: scale,
        maxPixels: 1e9,
      })
    );
    const count = countDict ? countDict[band] : null;
    console.log(`Region pixels used: ${count !== null ? count : 0}`);
    if (!count || count === 0) {
      console.log('No valid pixels after processing.');
      console.log('C2');
      return;
    }

    // 4. Calculation: mean over small buffer (represents local grid cell)
    const meanDict = await getInfo(
      img.select(band).reduceRegion({
        reducer: ee.Reducer.mean(),
        geometry: region,
        scale: scale,
        maxPixels: 1e9,
      })
    );
    const valK = meanDict ? meanDict[band] : null;
    if (valK === null || isNaN(valK) || valK < 150 || valK > 400) {
      console.log('Calculation invalid or out of realistic range.');
      console.log('C3');
      return;
    }
    const valC = valK - 273.15;

    // 5. Validation & Final Answer
    console.log(`Dataset used: ${dataset}`);
    console.log(`Daily max air temp (C): ${valC.toFixed(2)}`);
    console.log(`Threshold > 50 C: ${valC > 50}`);

    if (valC > 50) {
      console.log('A');
    } else {
      console.log('B');
    }
  } catch (err) {
    console.log(`Error: ${err}`);
    console.log('D');
  }
}

async function initEE() {
  await new Promise((resolve, reject) => {
    ee.data.authenticateViaPrivateKey(privateKey, resolve, reject);
  });
  await new Promise((resolve, reject) => {
    ee.initialize(null, null, resolve, reject);
  });
  await runAnalysis();
}

initEE();
```
